day_shape: CENTCOM confirms third round of strikes on Iran after IRGC attack on M/V GFS Galaxy in Hormuz; Iran-Oman hold Muscat talks on strait traffic; Mojtaba Khamenei issues burial-day revenge message; regime channels claim Sen. Lindsey Graham died aged 71.

threads.label: Hormuz strikes and Iran-Oman talks
threads.summary: CENTCOM said US forces launched a third round of strikes on Iran at 19:15 ET after IRGC attacked the Cyprus-flagged M/V GFS Galaxy, leaving one crew member missing and the vessel disabled. Iran and Oman held Muscat talks on managing Strait of Hormuz traffic, with spokesperson Baghaei saying arrangements must be set between the two littoral states; IRGC also claimed a second 'violating' vessel was struck.

threads.label: Mojtaba Khamenei burial message and revenge vow
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published the full burial-day message from new Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei, pledging to avenge his father's killing and thanking 'tens of millions' who attended processions in Tehran, Qom, Najaf, Karbala and Mashhad. Iran International reported Mojtaba doubled down on revenge after Trump vowed to 'decimate and destroy' Iran if targeted; a memorial ceremony is scheduled for Tuesday 23 Tir at Tehran's Mosalla.

threads.label: Iranian strike damage and ordnance clearance
threads.summary: Iranian provincial officials reported drone and projectile impacts around Yasuj, Khondab and three cities in Khuzestan (Hendijan, Mahshahr, Abadan), attributing them to 'American-Zionist' forces. IRGC and provincial crisis authorities announced controlled detonations of unexploded ordnance in Pakdasht, Isfahan and Tabriz through Sunday.

threads.label: Trump assassination-plot claim
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported US Ambassador Mike Huckabee confirmed Israel had warned Washington of a specific Iranian plan to assassinate President Trump. Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf posted on X that 'the era of one-sided deals is over,' citing clause five of the 14-point MoU on reopening Hormuz.

threads.label: South Lebanon strikes continue
threads.summary: The IDF said troops of the 91st Galilee Division struck Hezbollah operatives filmed moving anti-tank missiles into a building inside the south Lebanon buffer zone, with secondary explosions reported. Lebanese media and IRIB reported further Israeli strikes on Mansouri and shelling of Bayut al-Siyad in the south.

threads.label: Regime channels claim Graham death
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press posted multiple items claiming US Senator Lindsey Graham, 71, died Saturday evening of sudden illness, citing NBC News reporting of a cardiac-arrest call to his Capitol Hill home. The outlets described Graham as a leading advocate of military action against Iran.

threads.label: Iran wartime economy and diplomacy
threads.summary: Iran International reported Iran faces the region's harshest combination of wartime contraction and inflation, with households absorbing sanctions and mismanagement through job and income losses. IRIB reported Foreign Minister Araghchi spoke by phone with Pakistan's Ishaq Dar on regional developments.
